title: Deeper/broader InventorLoader source-route and solid-disposition audit
scope: Inspect the current InventorLoader DXF-to-SAT/SAB-to-FreeCAD route at source level
Separate payload extraction, ACIS parse, reader state, shape construction, fallback geometry, and solid semantics
Refresh open issue and release/provenance evidence without downloading attachments
Refine the existing optional S8 qualification gate without adding runtime dependencies or blocking local implementation

sources.name: InventorLoader DXF extraction wrapper
sources.observed: The wrapper calls ezdxf.readfile, iterates DXF entities, extracts nonempty SAT/SAB fields, and invokes a separate AcisReader. Parsed readers are stored in module-global state and named by a traversal counter; the shown path does not visibly carry the source DXF handle into the FreeCAD result.

sources.name: InventorLoader FreeCAD shape builder
sources.observed: The builder resolves ACIS references, attempts to create Part.Shell from faces, and falls back to individual faces on exception; wires are built/fused separately. Presence of a face, shell, wire, or STEP file does not establish a closed valid solid or source entity association.

sources.name: InventorLoader supported geometry and limitations
sources.observed: The README describes SAT/SAB/DXF import but no export, and lists unsupported blending/helix cases plus omission of law-defined curves/surfaces without spline data.

sources.name: InventorLoader issue 102
sources.observed: Open report of an attached SAB import raising a Python TypeError; the attachment was not downloaded or inspected.

sources.name: InventorLoader issue 103
sources.observed: Open report that the supplied SAT model produced no recognized face during shell construction; the attachment was not downloaded or inspected.

sources.name: InventorLoader issue 110
sources.observed: Open 2026 report gives a user workaround that retains the reader with setReader after readText succeeds, then converts through STEP/FreeCAD Part; it also reports messy normals. This is not a pinned upstream fix or independent qualification.

sources.name: InventorLoader releases
sources.observed: GitHub reports no formal releases. Existing plan research records package metadata 1.5.1 and a disagreement between package license metadata and repository LICENSE text; this pass does not resolve artifact provenance or licensing.

sources.name: InventorLoader package metadata and license text
sources.observed: The package metadata and repository license remain inconsistent in the previously reviewed snapshot; no code is copied, bundled, or executed as part of this research.

sources.name: FreeCAD stock DWG converter route
sources.observed: The stock application route remains an external DWG converter followed by the selected DXF importer; this is separate from the optional InventorLoader ACIS add-on route.

assessment.planImpact: Tightens only the optional existing S8 gate. A candidate run must bind source DXF entity and owner to exact carrier bytes/hash, parser outcome, all unsupported/fallback paths, and exactly mapped closed valid solid results with independent analytic metrics. InventorLoader is not stock FreeCAD behavior, does not parse DWG AcDs, and shares the FreeCAD/OCCT geometry-kernel lineage. Unavailable, unpinned, unsafe, or incomplete routes self-unblock as NOT_AVAILABLE/NOT_QUALIFIED without delaying local implementation.

implementationReadyChecks: At the existing composed S8 checkpoint only, pin the complete InventorLoader source SHA and exact FreeCAD/Python/ezdxf/OCCT tuple; resolve provenance/license and perform source-wide input-safety/resource review before giving it untrusted payloads.
Generate one asymmetric scratch-only DXF with two distinct ACIS payloads; build a source-handle/owner/type to ordered carrier/hash manifest before calling the peer route.
Record parser return/exception, reader lifetime/state, record count, unsupported entities, build errors, fallback use, and output object identity for every input body.

Require the expected number of closed valid solids and independently compare units, placement, bounds, centroid, volume/area, topology, and orientation; faces, wires, open shells, display output, or STEP existence alone are not a semantic pass.
Keep STOCK_FREECAD_CONVERTER_DXF_IMPORT separate from INVENTORLOADER_DXF_SAT_SAB_ADDON; neither result alone establishes DWG AcDs association or independent-kernel evidence.

If a prerequisite is unavailable or any required payload/profile/geometry is unsupported, record the exact NOT_AVAILABLE/NOT_QUALIFIED/INCOMPLETE stage and proceed with local fast slices. Do not add the plugin to CMake/CI, download or commit foreign drawings, or run full suites for this optional check.
limitations: Primary-source web review only. The add-on was not installed, built, or executed; no issue attachment or drawing was downloaded. Source safety, parser completeness, file-to-shape identity mapping, solids produced, and runtime behavior were not experimentally verified. FreeCAD and OCCT builds/platforms were not run. The local ODA v5.4.1 specification remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.
